## Cnidarian Stem Cells {#cnidarian-stem-cells}

Stem cells across cnidarians: single-cell RNA-seq of *Acropora cervicornis* and *Pocillopora damicornis* (all cells vs. ALDH+ libraries) and *Nematostella vectensis*.

::: {#l-stemcells}
:::

## Mnemiopsis Phagocytes {#mnemiopsis-phagocytes}

Functional characterization of putative immune cells in *Mnemiopsis leidyi*. [GitHub repo](https://github.com/kevinhwong1/Mnemi_Phagocyte)

::: {#l-mnemi}
:::

## Dark Genes {#dark-genes}

Thermally responsive unannotated genes and single-cell atlases in *Galaxea fascicularis* and other corals. [GitHub repo](https://github.com/kevinhwong1/DarkGenes_Bleaching_Comparison)

::: {#l-darkgenes}
:::
